verdict.rationale: Titan is a hardware FIDO authenticator with no software, CLI, API, or automation surface of its own, so bulk operations across many items does not apply to this kind of product. Fleet management runs through the separate Google Workspace Admin console. The single action that unpairs a key from all Bluetooth devices is a reset on one device, not bulk processing of items, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
